categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Rehearsal Hall
categories.info: Rehearsal Halls are large-scale challenges that focus on a specific Bananza form. They can only be accessed after finishing the story.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Extra-Rare Fossil
categories.info: Extra-Rare Fossils are used for the final upgrade of the showpiece Style Shop items.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Rare Fossil
categories.info: Rare Fossils are used to buy and upgrade showpiece Style Shop items, as well as buy the final upgrade of more common items.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: 01 - Beneath the White-Sand Landing

locations.title: 02 - Alighted in the Radiance Layer!

locations.title: 03 - Deep Down in Shedlight Cave

locations.title: 04 - Ssslithered Past Shedlight Cave!

locations.title: 05 - Shifty Smash: A Thorny Situation
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash](#loc=480397)

locations.title: 06 - A Light Snack

locations.title: 07 - Revealed by the Light
locations.description: **Location:** In the dark alcove; place a piece of Glowstone in the nearby brazier to reveal the gem.

locations.title: 08 - Glowing Fruit in the Darkness
locations.description: **Location:** [Dim Lights in the Darkness](#loc=480407) - On top of the first ledge.

locations.title: 09 - Sharp Eye for a Banana
locations.description: **Location:** [Dim Lights in the Darkness](#loc=480407) - After reaching the Crockoid, throw a Glowstone at the distant blue spring left of the main path to reveal the gem.

locations.title: 10 - Guided by Glowing Fruit
locations.description: **Location:** [Dim Lights in the Darkness](#loc=480407) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 11 - Adrift in Glowboa Grotto
locations.description: **Location:** Buried in the sand pile in the corner of the grotto.

locations.title: 12 - Battle: Some Light Smashing
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Radiance Layer Battle Challenge 1](#loc=480414)

locations.title: 13 - Sitting on a Snake's Head
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the snake-shaped corridor; use Snake Bananza to easily hop on top of it.

locations.title: 14 - Over the Elder's Head
locations.description: **Location:** Buried in the snow on top of a platform right above the elder. To access, climb the cliff behind him and Snake Bananza jump to it.

locations.title: 15 - Bathing in the Essence of the Sun
locations.description: **Location:** In the cavern left of the Elder, in a secret alcove at the bottom of the lava pit. Use Elephant Bananza to remove the lava and access the gem.

locations.title: 16 - Atop an Unlit Landing
locations.description: **Location:** On top of a platform, to the right of the ziplines.

locations.title: 17 - Skeaky Room Under Sand
locations.description: **Location:** [Snake Bananza: Charged Climb](#loc=480424) - In a secret room underneath the first patch of snow along the main path.

locations.title: 18 - Springing off Sandy Steps
locations.description: **Location:** [Snake Bananza: Charged Climb](#loc=480424) - Halfway down the course, on top of a snow patch.

locations.title: 19 - Swift and Shocking Ascent
locations.description: **Location:** [Snake Bananza: Charged Climb](#loc=480424) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 20 - The View beyond Glowboa Grotto
locations.description: **Location:** Only accessible after completing the layer; at the end of a small cave high against the wall. Use Snake Bananza to reach the entrance.

locations.title: 21 - Ran the First Scale!
locations.description: **Location:** [Snake Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=480429) - At the top of the First Scale.

locations.title: 22 - Summited the Snaking Path
locations.description:
**Location:** [Snake Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=480429) - From [21 - Ran the First Scale!](#loc=480430):
- Use the left-most cannon
- Ascend by jumping through the snaking ascending stone path
- When you reach a series of floating gold orbs, jump through to latch on a mesh and access the gem.

locations.title: 23 - Ran the Second Scale!
locations.description:
**Location:** [Snake Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=480429) - From [21 - Ran the First Scale!](#loc=480430):
- Use the cannon on the central platform.
- Ascend each structure by blowing up a piece of spiked concrete at the bottom, then ascending alongside the hole to jump through at the top.
- The gem sits at the very top of the third ascension.

locations.title: 24 - Floated Aloft with Laser Precision
locations.description:
**Location:** From [23 - Ran the Second Glare!](#loc=480437):
- Use the left-most cannon to reach the cylindrical island
- Ascend to the top of the pillar using LIftoff Ore; use Glare to easily navigate the lasers.
- Jump from the top pillar to a mesh with the gem.

locations.title: 25 - Ran the Third Scale!
locations.description:
**Location:** [Snake Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=480429) - From [23 - Ran the Second Glare!](#loc=480437):
- Use the cannon on the central platform.
- Ascend the third scale, jumping from platform to platform and punching the blue balloons to move them around. Use Glare to slow their movements.
- The gems sits at the top of the scale.

locations.title: 26 - Snaked by without Going Boom
locations.description:
**Location:** [Snake Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=480429) - From [25 - Ran the Third Scale!](#loc=480441):
- Use the left-most cannon to reach the bomb-covered stone structure.
- Quickly ascend the stone structure before the bombs go off; use Glare to gain more time.
- Jump from the top of the structure to a mesh with the gem.

locations.title: 27 - Ran the Fourth Scale!
locations.description:
**Location:** [Snake Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=480429) - From [25 - Ran the Third Scale!](#loc=480441):
- Use the cannon on the central platform
- Ascend to the top of the tower, timing charged jumps through the quickly approaching dirt blocks.
- The gem sits atop the tower.

locations.title: 28 - Sink like a Crock
locations.description:
**Location:** [Snake Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=480429) - From [27 - Ran the Fourth Scale!](#loc=480443):
- Use the left-most cannon to the circular island.
- Destroy all 3 Crockoids. To do so, create holes in the concrete floor and have them fall into them. This wall spawn the gem at the beginning of the platform.

locations.title: 29 - Ran the Final Scale!
locations.description:
**Location:** [Snake Elder's Rehearsal Hall](#loc=480429) - From [27 - Ran the Fourth Scale!](#loc=480443):
- Use the cannon on the central platform
- Ascend to the top of the Wallopoid blocks. Use Glare to move quickly before they fall down, and remember that you can ascend from behind them so they don't trigger.
- The gem sits at the end of the course.

locations.title: 30 - Radiance Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Location:** Bought from the [Chip Exchange](#loc=480448)

locations.title: 31 - Unveiled in the Sculptor's Studio!
locations.description: **Location:** Beside the arrival point in Sculptor's Studio.

locations.title: 32 - Battle: Shining Through
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Radiance Layer Battle Challenge 2](#loc=480451)

locations.title: 33 - Ceiling Swingin' Snack
locations.description: **Location:** In a room at the bottom of a crystal-covered pit. Smash the crystal to access. Then, use Snake Bananza to jump to the mesh; follow the mesh to the gem.

locations.title: 34 - Staying Fresh in the Storeroom
locations.description: **Location:** Beyond the glowing gate, at the end of the tunnel

locations.title: 35 - Battle: Dive-Bombing Run
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Radiance Layer Battle Challenge 3](#loc=480455)

locations.title: 36 - Perfectly Preserved in Crystal
locations.description: **Location:** In the middle of a large ice chunk.

locations.title: 37 - Shifty Smash: A Dark Climb
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash](#loc=480459)

locations.title: 38 - Soaking in the Essence of the Sun
locations.description: **Location:** On the bottom floor of tower, in the lava pool in the corner. Use Elephant Bananza to remove the lava and access the gem.

locations.title: 39 - Warmed by Flaming Barrels
locations.description: **Location:** In the platforming section against the back wall; use Snake Bananza to reach it from below.

locations.title: 40 - Safe in the Barrel-Free Zone
locations.description: **Location:** Halfway up the wall, behind the ever-flowing barrels. Slow down time then weave between them to access.

locations.title: 41 - Summited in the Solar Control Tower
locations.description: **Location:** At the top of the tower, near the checkpoint.

locations.title: 42 - Hidden in the Girders
locations.description: **Location:** [Arcade Country](#loc=481628) - Run the course until you have to go left for the first time. Soon after, you will encounter a dirt platform with no sign on it; Hand Slap it to rise to the banana.

locations.title: 43 - Jumpin' Like Jumpman
locations.description: **Location:** [Arcade Country](#loc=481628) - Halfway up the course, at the end of the first left-facing section.

locations.title: 44 - Climbing to a High Score
locations.description: **Location:** [Arcade Country](#loc=481628) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 45 - Wishing on a Synthetic Sun
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the Solar Control Tower roof.

locations.title: 46 - Settled upon Serpent Sands!
locations.description: **Location:** Halfway buried in the sand, beside the checkpoint.

locations.title: 47 - Balloons Under the Dunes
locations.description:
**Location:** In the cave underneath [Serpent Sands](#loc=481633); break the Void Machine to access. This gem requires collecting five yellow balloons, each trapped inside a Trapantuloid.  
- Two of them are roaming on the bottom floor of the cavern
- One is on the platform by the return barrel, behind a concrete wall.
- One is on a higher platform, at the end of a vine-covered hallway
- The final is in a dark cavern on a high ice platform. Use the nearby Glowstone to illuminate the hallway.

locations.title: 48 - Obssscured in a Dune Cave Nook
locations.description: **Location:** In the cave underneath [Serpent Sands](#loc=481633); break the Void Machine to access. Along the walls of the cavern is an ice path to climb on. Head to the highest accessible nook to find the gem.

locations.title: 49 - Deep in a Dune Cave Hallway
locations.description: **Location:** In the cave underneath [Serpent Sands](#loc=481633); break the Void Machine to access. At the end of the vine-covered hallway, beyond the trapezoid, is a Glowstone tile. Break it to access the gem.

locations.title: 50 - Bloomed in the Radiance Layer
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the ring of concrete; speak to the Bloomintone once light has reached it.

locations.title: 51 - Battle: Shadows and Sunlight
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Radiance Layer Battle Challenge 4](#loc=481639)

locations.title: 52 - Shifty Smash: Timing is Everything
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash](#loc=481641)

locations.title: 53 - Radiance Fragmenstone Recovery
locations.description: **Location:** In a cave, accessed by breaking the snow tile in the ice snake's mouth. Bring back one mini Fragmenstone to the larger one; use the Glowstone to guide your path and avoid the water.

locations.title: 54 - Radiance Fragmenstone Restoration
locations.description: **Location:** In a cave, accessed by breaking the snow tile in the ice snake's mouth. Bring back the final two mini Fragmenstones to the larger one; use the Glowstone to guide your path and avoid the water.

locations.title: 55 - Battle: Vaulting Virtuoso
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Radiance Layer Battle Challenge 5](#loc=481645)

locations.title: 56 - Radiance Smashin' Stats
locations.description: **Location:** Given by the Smashintone (in the secret storeroom underneath the Oasis; jump through the hole to access) after smashing 70,000 cubic meters of Crystal material across the layer.

locations.title: 57 - Lit-Path Switchback
locations.description: **Location:** [Surfing in Shadow](#loc=481650) - From [58 - Shadow-Path Rest Stop](#loc=481663), head down a level and grab the Illuminoid's body. Then, double back, this time surfing in the sunlit areas and taking the curved path to the gem.

locations.title: 58 - Shadow-Path Rest Stop
locations.description: **Location:** [Surfing in Shadow](#loc=481650) - Surf your way across the vines using a Gloominoid's body, avoiding the sunlight to keep the chunk intact.

locations.title: 59 - Shadow-Path Finish Line
locations.description: **Location:** [Surfing in Shadow](#loc=481650) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 60 - Tip 'o the Stone Snake's Tongue
locations.description: **Location:** On the ice snake's tongue, covered in Void Material. From the gem, dig through the snake's mouth and destroy the Void Machine to unlock.

locations.title: 61 - Hanging Out beneath the Oasis
locations.description: **Location:** Underneath the observation deck, stuck to the ceiling of the chamber. Either use Ostrich Bananza to fly to it, or use Elephant Bananza to clear out the lava, followed by Snake to jump to it.

locations.title: 62 - The Radiance Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Appears on the Growtone once you've fed it at least 500 Gold.

locations.title: 63 - The Hungry Radiance Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Appears on the Growtone once you've fed it at least 2,000 Gold.

locations.title: 64 - The Sated Radiance Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Appears on the Growtone once you've fed it at least 4,000 Gold.

locations.title: 65 - Grown beneath the Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Hanging underneath the ledge with the Growtone; use Snake Bananza from directly underneath to reach it.

locations.title: 66 - Cranky's Radiance Rant

locations.title: 67 - Under the Viper's Chinny-Chin-Chin

locations.title: 68 - Battle: Open the Window

locations.title: 69 - Head in the Shade Clouds

locations.title: 70 - Pillaged from a Shade-Cloud Pillar

locations.title: 71 - Walkin' on Shade Clouds

locations.title: 72 - Crashed the Crystal-Cobra Den!

locations.title: 73 - Hidden in the Moving Wall

locations.title: 74 - Sticking to the Shadows

locations.title: 75 - Through Shadows and Thorns

locations.title: 76 - Swallowed by the Snake
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the crystal snake beside the [Crystal-Cobra Den Getaway](#loc=481689)

locations.title: Black Britches
locations.description:
**Effect:** Reduces damage from enemies by 10 percent.

**Cost:** 1 Banana Bird

locations.title: Defense Britches
locations.description:
**Effect:** Reduces damage taken from enemies by 20 percent.

**Cost:** 5 Banana Birds

**Upgrades:**
- Increase to 25 percent: 10x Banana Birds
- Increase to 30 percent: 3x Armadillos

locations.title: Banandium Chip Bolo
locations.description:
**Effect:** Increases the chance of doubling any Banandium Chips you collect by 20 percent.

**Cost:** 1 Armadillo

**Upgrades:**
- Increase to 30 percent: 3x Armadillos
- Increase to 40 percent: 1x Sea Urchin
